01 / FLAGSHIP PROJECT

Predict failures before they stop production.

A demonstration case study showing how I frame, build, and operationalize a predictive-maintenance system—from raw sensor readings to a maintenance queue.

REAL DATA · METROPT-3

24-hour failure risk for a metro compressor

Evaluated on operational compressor telemetry and four documented failure incidents. Forward validation shows weak generalization; the final holdout reveals the alert burden alongside detections.

0.012Holdout PR–AUC
81.6%Recall · 24h windows
1.7%Precision · high alert burden
Model discrimination
XGBoost Baseline
DATA

1,516,948 operational readings aggregated into 25,594 ten-minute windows.

VALIDATION

Forward validation on earlier incidents; final July incident held out chronologically.

RESULT

84 true-positive windows and 4,943 false-positive windows at the recall-focused threshold. The baseline needs substantial improvement.
